notes.title: Major update production confirmed
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033208/fb0c52aecb737dc5316d2575f6988087897306fb.jpg[/img]

The production of a major update for BURGGEIST has been confirmed.
New elements such as the construction site of a new tower, the stories of visitors, and Gyromantia will be added, among various other features.
This update will be provided free of charge and is scheduled to be released in the same manner as regular updates.

The release date is scheduled for 2025.
As soon as a detailed schedule is finalized, we will announce it on our SNS([url=https://x.com/GhrianStudio]X-Twitter[/url]).

tags.feature: New elements such as the construction site of a new tower, the stories of visitors, and Gyromantia will be added, among various other features.

notes.title: Patch 1.08 The Circle Collector appears
notes.content:
The Circle Collector statue appears in the field.
- It will point you in the direction of unacquired equipment when approaching.
- If the target equipment has already been acquired, it will not appear.

Penetration Spear
- Changed the animation when used on the ground and adjusted the base damage.
- Fixed collision to make it easier to hit.


- HL Rotarygun animation, FX and SFX were changed.
- The cumulative total of correction values is now displayed in the equipment UI.
- Some graphic assets were modified.

- Fixed UI and other bugs.

notes.title: Patch 1.05 - New map system Added
notes.content:
New map system
- Open overlaid map with "View button" or "M key" in default settings
* Please note that you are already using M key in keyboard settings.

Event tracking system
- Tracking settings can be made in the menu “MAP&COMM”.
- The tracking settings will be marked on overlaid map.


- Updated Burggeist's follow system.
- Equipment "Roselha-Grande Earrings" was adjusted.
- Basic value of "Tower auto-repair" in the difficulty "Story" was adjusted.

- Fixed a movement bug that occurs with certain enemies.
- Fixed a text bug.
- Fixed a bug in the background object.
